start.title: Portfolio & Analysis
start.subtitle: Add an address or ask the AI — the input field is at the bottom.
start.emptyDescription: Add an address, import a CSV/Excel file, or ask about the portfolio — e.g. "Which locations drive the EAL?"
start.inputHint: Enter an address or question · import via 📎 CSV, TSV, or Excel (.xlsx) · columns: name, address, lat, lon, value

command.title: Command Palette
command.description: Search for a command to run…

parameters.title: Model parameters
parameters.description: Adjust risk, exposure, portfolio and data-quality parameters for this session. Changes are applied to existing scores after leaving a field and saved automatically.
parameters.cardDescription: Changes apply to the next calculation.
parameters.startHereDescription: For most portfolios, the marked settings are enough. They directly affect exposure, EAL, or alerts; everything else remains available under “Advanced parameters”.
parameters.fractionHint: Guidance: enter fractions as decimals — 0.15 means 15%. Changes are applied when you leave a field.
parameters.loadErrorDescription: The rest of the app remains available. Try loading the parameters page again.

exposure.title: Exposure & capacity
exposure.description: Values and area assumptions that determine financial exposure.

risk.title: Risk & EAL
risk.description: Damage shares and occurrence probabilities for the EAL calculation.

scores.title: Peril scores
scores.description: Thresholds at which measured values reach their maximum peril score.

portfolio.title: Portfolio, PML & scenarios
portfolio.description: Concentration risk, reinsurance and portfolio-level stress scenarios.

quality.title: Alerts & data quality
quality.description: Thresholds for alerts, reviews and the quality of automated results.

vehicleValueCarEur.label: Passenger-car value
vehicleValueCarEur.tip: Adjust this if the typical vehicle mix differs materially from the default value.

vehicleValueDefaultEur.label: Default vehicle value
vehicleValueDefaultEur.description: Fallback when the vehicle class is unknown.

capacitySqmPerVehicle.label: Area per vehicle
capacitySqmPerVehicle.description: Assumption used to estimate site capacity.
capacitySqmPerVehicle.tip: The most important lever for estimated capacity when no reliable vehicle count is available.

hailDamageFraction.label: Hail damage share
hailDamageFraction.description: Share of damage for each affected event.
hailDamageFraction.tip: Estimates what share of exposed vehicle value is damaged when a site is hit.

hailSiteHitProbability.label: Hail hit probability
hailSiteHitProbability.description: Probability that the site is hit.
hailSiteHitProbability.tip: Change only if your own claims history or a different peril model supports it.

climateLoadingFactor.label: Climate loading
climateLoadingFactor.description: Multiplicative loading applied to hail frequency.
climateLoadingFactor.tip: Increases modeled hail frequency; 0.15 represents a 15% loading.

windStormThresholdKmh.label: Storm threshold
windStormThresholdKmh.description: Wind damage is modeled above this wind speed.

windDamageFraction.label: Wind damage share
windDamageFraction.description: Share of damage per modeled storm day.
windDamageFraction.tip: Describes the average loss severity on a day classified as a storm.

lightningDamageFraction.label: Lightning damage share
lightningDamageFraction.description: Share of damage per lightning event.

snowLoadDamageFractionPer30cm.label: Snow-load share per 30 cm
snowLoadDamageFractionPer30cm.description: Share of damage per 30 cm of snow depth.

floodDamageHq10.label: Flood damage share HQ10
floodDamageHq10.description: Damage share in the 10-year proxy scenario.

floodDamageHq100.label: Flood damage share HQ100
floodDamageHq100.description: Damage share in the 100-year proxy scenario.
floodDamageHq100.tip: Change only when robust flood assumptions are available for the relevant sites.

floodDamageHqExtrem.label: Extreme flood damage share
floodDamageHqExtrem.description: Damage share in the extreme proxy scenario.

heatHotdaysScoreMax.label: Hot days for score 100
heatHotdaysScoreMax.description: Number of hot days needed for the maximum heat score.

heatDamageFractionPerHotday.label: Heat damage share per hot day
heatDamageFractionPerHotday.description: Share of damage per hot day.

windScoreMaxKmh.label: Wind at score 100
windScoreMaxKmh.description: Wind speed for the maximum wind score.
windScoreMaxKmh.tip: Useful when the score should follow an internal threshold model.

lightningScoreMaxDensity.label: Lightning density at score 100
lightningScoreMaxDensity.description: Lightning density for the maximum lightning score.

snowScoreMaxCm.label: Snow at score 100
snowScoreMaxCm.description: Snow depth for the maximum snow score.

floodScoreMaxAnnualPrecipMm.label: Precipitation at score 100
floodScoreMaxAnnualPrecipMm.description: Annual precipitation for the maximum flood score.
floodScoreMaxAnnualPrecipMm.tip: Defines the annual precipitation at which the flood score reaches its maximum.

pmlDamageFraction100.label: PML damage share, 100 years
pmlDamageFraction100.tip: The key PML assumption for an infrequent but severe event.

pmlClusterRadiusKm.label: PML cluster radius
pmlClusterRadiusKm.description: Radius used for the largest PML exposure.

accumulationRadiusKm.label: Accumulation radius
accumulationRadiusKm.description: Distance within which sites are grouped.
accumulationRadiusKm.tip: Sets how close several sites must be to count as one concentration risk.

accumulationReinsureThresholdEur.label: Reinsurance threshold
accumulationReinsureThresholdEur.description: Reinsurance is recommended above this accumulated exposure.
accumulationReinsureThresholdEur.tip: An operational threshold for the reinsurance alert.

scenarioDamageLow.label: Low scenario damage share
scenarioDamageLow.description: Damage share in the low stress scenario.

scenarioDamageMedium.label: Medium scenario damage share
scenarioDamageMedium.description: Damage share in the medium stress scenario.

scenarioDamageHigh.label: High scenario damage share
scenarioDamageHigh.description: Damage share in the high stress scenario.

scenarioDamageExtreme.label: Extreme scenario damage share
scenarioDamageExtreme.description: Damage share in the extreme stress scenario.

alertExtremeScore.label: Risk-score alert threshold
alertExtremeScore.description: A critical alert is created from this score onward.
alertExtremeScore.tip: Lower means more alerts; higher highlights only the most critical locations.

alertOvercapacity.label: Overcapacity alert threshold
alertOvercapacity.description: Utilisation above this factor creates an alert.
alertOvercapacity.tip: 1.0 represents 100% utilisation. Values above 1.0 allow the corresponding buffer.

alertLowBoundaryConfidence.label: Boundary-confidence alert threshold
alertLowBoundaryConfidence.description: Below this value, the site boundary is treated as uncertain.

alertEalPortfolioShare.label: EAL-share alert threshold
alertEalPortfolioShare.description: Portfolio share above which a site is highlighted.

boundaryReviewConfidence.label: Boundary-review confidence
boundaryReviewConfidence.description: A review is required below this confidence.

boundaryReviewTop2Margin.label: Boundary-review top-two margin
boundaryReviewTop2Margin.description: Minimum difference between the best and second-best candidate.

syntheticBoundaryRadiusM.label: Synthetic boundary radius
syntheticBoundaryRadiusM.description: Fallback radius when no geometry is available.

detectionConfidence.label: Detection confidence
detectionConfidence.description: Minimum confidence required from the vehicle model.
detectionConfidence.tip: Lower detects more vehicles but may introduce more false positives; higher is more conservative.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored via safeStorage in the OS keychain — never in plaintext.
settings.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for the official endpoint. For a proxy use e.g. http://localhost:6655/openai/v1 (OpenAI/Custom) or http://localhost:6655/anthropic (Claude).
settings.apiKeySetPlaceholder: •••••••• (stored) — enter a new key to replace

natCat.title: Natural catastrophe data source
natCat.description: ZÜRS files are detected automatically during CSV/Excel import. CatNet is queried only through a licensed HTTPS endpoint.
natCat.endpointHint: Enter the exact URL from the Swiss Re API documentation (HTTPS required).

satelliteSource.title: Aerial Imagery Source
satelliteSource.tileTemplateHint: XYZ/WMS URL with {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders. Falls back to Esri without a valid template.

model.title: Install vehicle-detection model
model.description: Without this model, the app only estimates vehicle counts from the lot area instead of detecting vehicles with AI in the aerial imagery.
model.ready: The local AI model is already installed. You can start using the app.
model.idle: The model (YOLOv26s, approx. 36 MB) will be downloaded once and stored locally.
model.done: Model installed — real AI vehicle detection is now active.
model.unavailable: Automatic download is not yet set up. Please place the model file here manually:

hail.lowDetail: Hail score {{score}}/100 — area with low hail exposure.

limit.warningDetail: Exposure {{exposure}} is approaching the product limit ({{limit}}). A medium-sized nat-cat event would cause a loss of {{loss}}.
